plugins.name: openkt
plugins.description: Persistent memory + auto-recall hooks for Claude Code. Captures decisions, anti-patterns, and project facts across sessions; injects relevant memories on every prompt.

plugins.name: openkt-demos
plugins.description: Build interactive, publishable HTML demos in the OpenKT design language — tabs, knowledge-graph visualizations, drill-down panels, warm-paper editorial styling. Turn specs, reports, and analyses into shareable single-page demos, then export a self-contained file for your website.

plugins.name: living-pages
plugins.description: Pages you can mark up. Turns any folder of HTML into a live commenting surface — highlight text, select elements, leave notes. Your agent reads the margins and revises; the page reloads with a walkthrough of what changed.
